data.title: Sofitel Residences
data.about:
Sofitel Residences Downtown by Azha Development introduces an elevated living experience in the heart of Dubai’s most prestigious address. With only 64 residences and 6 penthouses, this boutique development blends French neoclassical elegance with contemporary Middle Eastern influences. Choose from 1–3 bedroom apartments or 4–5 bedroom penthouses, each serviced and managed by the globally renowned Accor Group.

Residents will enjoy a host of Sofitel Dubai Downtown amenities, including a private lounge, immersive cinema, children's creativity area, and a wellness-focused fitness center. Strategically located for seamless city access, the project offers a 40/60 payment plan with just 10% down payment. Ownership also includes VVIP global privileges via the Accor network, making this a truly exclusive investment opportunity.

characteristics_module.title: Choose Sofitel Residence Downtown for a Lifestyle of Comfort, Convenience, and Luxury
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive residential tower with only 70 units, ensuring privacy and exclusivity.
  • Prime central location with easy access to vibrant hotspots and major attractions.
  • Variety of units including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments as well as luxurious penthouses to cater to diverse needs.
  • Unfurnished units allow residents the freedom to personalize and design their living space.
  • The hotel-like Sofitel Dubai Downtown amenities include housekeeping, maintenance, and concierge services.
  • Affordable service charges estimated between AED 40 to AED 50 per square foot.
  • Managed by Accor Hotels, a renowned hospitality brand, guaranteeing top-notch service and quality.

location_tile.title: Experience Convenience and Connectivity at Its Best
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
With major business districts like Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and iconic landmarks such as Burj Khalifa just a short distance away, Sofitel Residences Downtown location offers both convenience and connectivity. The vibrant nightlife at spots like Armani/Privé and numerous recreational spots including Dubai Opera and Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo ensure there's always something to do, making Sofitel Residence Downtown the perfect choice for those seeking a vibrant and luxurious urban lifestyle.

  • Dubai Mall within Walking Distance
  • 9 Minutes - Business Bay
  • 13 Minutes - Coca Cola Arena
  • 11 Minutes - City Walk

seo.metaTitle: Sofitel Residences Dubai at Downtown Dubai | Luxury Branded Living by Accor
seo.metaDescription: Discover Sofitel Residences Dubai at Downtown Dubai by Azha Development. Experience French-inspired luxury with world-class amenities, exclusive Accor privileges, and a prime city location.

more_info.answer: Sofitel Residences Downtown offers a variety of units to cater to different needs, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments as well as 4 and 5-bedroom penthouses. Each unit is unfurnished, allowing residents the freedom to personalize their living space.
more_info.question: What types of units are available at Sofitel Residences Downtown?

more_info.answer: Sofitel Residences Downtown offers a fitness center, cinema room, private lounge, children's area, and optional services like childcare, dog walking, and private transport. Residents also enjoy exclusive privileges through the Accor Ownership Benefits Program.
more_info.question: What amenities are provided at Sofitel Residences Downtown?

more_info.answer: The starting price for units at Sofitel Residences Downtown is AED 2.5 million. The payment plan is structured as 40% during construction and 60% upon handover, with the expected handover date in 2026. This flexible payment plan makes it easier for potential buyers to secure their dream home in this luxurious development.
